Name: Anvil Liberator
Description:
Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace
Focus: Transporter

Anvil continues its tradition of excellence with the Liberator, an open-air vehicle carrier that applies the tradition of long-range transport to a smaller scale. Designed to be as capable as similarly spec’d military carriers but tailored to the civilian market, the Liberator puts your fleet on the front lines of any operation.
